items.title: George Benson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Good King Bad, Benson and Farrell.

ctx.x: That’s it. There was Body Talk, and then there was . . .
Good King Bad, after Bad Benson. I’ll run down your CTI, starting with Beyond the Blue Horizon, White Rabbit, Body Talk, Bad Benson, Good King Bad, Benson and Farrell.
White Rabbit was a gigantic record . . .
